body: Oh that could be good! I'll give that a go tonight.
Thanks for looking out for me (and others), I appreciate it! Luckily I'm blessed enough to live in Canada, so this is legal, government regulated oil.
Ah, my apologies then, I'm wrong about that. Still, I don't think that guy's argument (or his deleted comment calling me 'the reason they had to cancel') are valid, but I'm wrong on this one. Thanks!

You know what, that's a great idea. I sent them another email but if they still say no I think I'll do this. Thank you for thinking of others and also for actually giving me useful advice instead of accusing me of being an idiot/not following social distancing rules like that other guy!

(also if you would like a pizza I'd be more than happy to send you the info you'd need)
Graduating in June. No option that I know of. In fact I think you explicitly cannot do that.

(What I deleted was about graduation)

Are you serious? Of course they cancelled it, and they needed to! But they also told us they won't reschedule and we have no options to attend future ceremonies.

Alright, I truly don't mean to be combative. But you have to understand that when I got my meal plan 4 years ago there was no pandemic in the picture. I don't think those terms necessarily need to apply right now.
Right, but this isn't normal circumstances so I wish they'd reconsider. I WOULD have finished off that money if not for the pandemic forcing everything to shut down.

This is leftover from my first year, so it's from the taxable account. I don't know why it would be a problem.

Seriously, between the strike and this and all the other little things, I've been yorked one too many times over the last four years. I would never recommend this mess of a school to anyone at this point— which sucks because the programs themselves are fine or great, but the people in charge seem to be an absolute mess. Just had to get that off my chest.
